scope: Independent source-bound review of identity, full-text claims, method, quotations, category relevance and conversion limits. This receipt grants no human verification, promotion or publication authority.

findings.finding: The ACL Version of Record title, authors, DOI and publication context match the reference. All three literal quotations resolve exactly in the bound source.

The document accurately describes the controlled vision-language bias probes, the preliminary object sets and the expanded survey-derived set. It preserves the paper’s distinction between observed model behavior and broader interpretation.

KI_Sonstige, Gender and Bias_Ungleichheit are central under categories.yaml. Diversitaet is appropriately described as relevant through the explicit non-binary and transgender limitation and the call for more inclusive datasets. Fairness, Generative_KI, Prompting, AI_Literacies, Feministisch and Soziale_Arbeit are correctly not asserted.
The conversion does not decode several formulas and does not preserve the visual content of figures. The knowledge document states this boundary and avoids figure-dependent quantitative claims.
